scenario: AITA For Banning My Sisters Ex Husband From Coming to Family Events and Causing Drama? | So this situation has been going on for some time now and I’m turning to an outside source for critique. For context I’m a thirty six year old women, my sister is thirty four. My sister has three kids with her ex husband and I have four with my husband. This entire saga traumatized my younger sister and the divorce was rough. I’m completely disgusted with my ex brother in law and so is my entire inner family. We’ve completely cut contact with him. My sister is the only one that communicates with him. My parents, other siblings, extended family do not interact with him. I always host family events at my house. Ever since the whole divorce I don’t want my ex brother in law in my home. He’s no longer invited to any events. My sister was upset and said that her kids would be upset to not have their dad at big events like this. She said she hates him for cheating but accepts that she has kids with him so they are stuck together for life. But I have the right to not want someone I hate in my home and at my events. I stood by firmly and my husband agreed with me. Her kids got upset that I didn’t want their dad at any events and my kids now hate their ex uncle (even though I haven’t ever spoken to them about the situation). It was my daughters birthday this January and I was throwing a very extravagant party. I rented out an amusement park for the day and my daughters entire grade came. Parents of course as they are fourth graders and my sisters son wanted his father there and of course I let him know my rule stands. My sister got upset and says that she can fight her own battles and that banning him makes me an asshole. My sister has always allowed this guy to walk all over her and always defends him. Am I wrong for not wanting him at events and parties I throw? I just don’t see it.
